issue.body:
Hi, the install script in the scripts directory needs a little fix, either the shebang can be changed to

```
#/bin/bash -e
```

or the double square brackets comparisons must go as they're not an `sh` thing.

When I tried run ./scripts/install I've got errors:

```
./scripts/install: 4: ./scripts/install: [[: not found
./scripts/install: 9: ./scripts/install: [[: not found 
```

I can submit a PR but I'd like to know what would you think the fix should be.
issue.title: install scripts
